name: Qatari Nationality, Proven Qatari Origin (Law No. 38 of 2005, Article 7.1)

qualifying_event.description: A person who can prove Qatari origin -- distinct from having a currently-Qatari father under Article 1.4 -- may be granted nationality after a substantially reduced residence period, per Article 7.1 of Law No. 38 of 2005.
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: Documentary or genealogical evidence of Qatari origin.

requirements.blocker_text: 3 consecutive years of legal residence -- reduced from the standard 25-year naturalisation requirement.
requirements.fix_path: Accumulate 3 years of continuous legal residence.

evidence_required.document: Genealogical or documentary evidence of Qatari origin
Proof of 3 years' continuous legal residence

sources.title: American University in Cairo, Center for Migration and Refugee Studies -- verbatim English translation of Law No. 38 of 2005, Article 7.1: persons proving Qatari origin require only 3 consecutive years of residence, versus the standard 25 years under Article 2

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Qatar). STATUS: DRAFT -- same tier-2 sourcing caveat as the other Qatari citizenship files. This is Qatar's closest analog to an 'ancestry-adjacent' fast-track: 3 years vs. the standard 25, an 8-to-1 reduction, among the steepest such discounts found in this dataset. Modeled deliberately narrowly -- as proving PERSONAL Qatari origin, not a multi-generation descendant-of-emigrants scheme like Romania's Article 10/11 reacquisition route -- since the source text does not describe a broader diaspora-facing mechanism. This does NOT overlap with qa_citizenship_by_descent.json (Article 1.4, current Qatari father) -- Article 7.1 covers people who are not automatically citizens under Article 1.4 but can still evidence Qatari-origin ancestry.
